title: Object reconstruction via jsonpickle.decode (python) — review required
description: jsonpickle is not a JSON parser: it honors py/object metadata and instantiates the named classes while decoding, so a valid-looking document can call constructors and setters that plain json.loads never would. This lexical rule flags jsonpickle.decode in python; it does not resolve whether the payload is trusted.
remediation: Decode untrusted documents with json.loads and map the resulting primitives explicitly. When object graphs are genuinely required, restrict jsonpickle to payloads the service produced itself and authenticate them first.
limitation: Lexical call match on jsonpickle.decode; reachable classes and payload provenance are out of scope.
